mapper.insert: insert into stad_wallet (user_id, balance, total_recharge, total_withdraw, freeze_amount, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{balance}, #{totalRecharge}, #{totalWithdraw}, #{freezeAmount}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update stad_wallet set balance = #{balance}, total_recharge = #{totalRecharge}, total_withdraw = #{totalWithdraw}, freeze_amount = #{freezeAmount}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id}
